title_sq: Vile private ne shitje ne zonen e Don Bosco prane kompleksit Vizion Plus (ID 4151040).
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Don Bosco prane kompleksit Vizion Plus, shitet vile private 3 kateshe.
E mobiluar, me hipoteke, siperfaqja e viles 500 m², siperfaqja e oborrit+ truallit te viles 388 m².
Kati i 1 150 m², kati i 2 150 m², kat i 3 100 m², 11 dhoma ne total, 5 tualete, korridore, ballkone + verande ku siperfaqja e tyre shkon 100 m², holli i katit te 1 dhe te 2 eshte i shtruar me mermer, punimet dhe rikonstruksionet e bera se fundmi, vend parkimi dhe oborr i gjelberuar.
Aktualisht i dhene me qera 1500 euro.
Cmimi 850 000 euro.
title_en: Private villa for sale in the area of ​​Don Bosco near the Vizion Plus complex (ID 4151040).
description_en: In the area of ​​Don Bosco, near the Vizion Plus complex, a 3-storey private villa is for sale. Furnished, with mortgage, the area of ​​the villa 500 m², the area of ​​the yard + plot of the villa 388 m². 1st floor 150 m², 2nd floor 150 m², 3rd floor 100 m², 11 rooms in total, 5 toilets, corridors, balconies + verandas where their surface is 100 m², the lobby of the 1st and 2nd floor is paved with marble, works and reconstructions done recently, parking space and green yard. It is currently rented for 1500 euros. The price is 850,000 euros.
